name: cavemio-mention-menu
title: Mentions and commands
description: Type @ to pull in context or / for a command. The menu grows from the caret and your text becomes a chip.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The field is a combobox: the open menu is a listbox and the active row is announced through aria-activedescendant.
- Arrow keys move, Enter or Tab picks, Escape closes; clicking a row keeps the caret in the field.
- Typing in an IME (Japanese, Chinese, Korean) never opens or submits mid-composition, and pasting always inserts plain text.
- @ only opens after a space or at the start, so email addresses don’t open the menu.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: triggers
props.description: – · Each opening character, its menu name, and its items or a search (sync or async) that gets the query.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: – · Enter sends. text writes mentions as "@label"; segments keep the order for rendering.

props.name: onChange
props.description: – · Called on every edit, e.g. to enable a send button.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: – · Starting text and chips, e.g. a draft.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: "Ask anything" · Shown while the field is empty; also its label.

props.name: side
props.description: "top" · Open above the caret (composers at the bottom of the screen) or below it.

props.name: anchorRef
props.description: – · Open clear of this element, e.g. your composer, so the menu never covers it.

props.name: ref
props.description: – · Focus the field, or clear it after sending.

useCases.title: AI prompt boxes
useCases.description: Type @ to attach files, pages or people as context for the model.

useCases.title: Slash commands
useCases.description: Type / at the start of a line to pick a command.

useCases.title: Comments and team chat
useCases.description: Mention teammates with @ and keep them as chips in the text.

useCases.title: Notes and task editors
useCases.description: Link to other items from inside the text you are writing.

features.title: A menu at the caret
features.description: You define the triggers: @ for files, people and pages, / for commands. The menu grows from where the person is typing.

features.title: It narrows as you type
features.description: Results rank by match, the matching text is bold and a highlight slides between rows.

features.title: Async search
features.description: Earlier results stay up while the next ones load. With nothing to show, “Searching” morphs into “No matches for …”.

features.title: Text becomes a chip
features.description: Enter or Tab turns the typed token into a chip in place, and Backspace removes the whole chip.

features.title: It doesn’t fire by accident
features.description: @ opens only after a space or at the start, so email addresses don’t open it. IME composition never submits early.

features.title: Opens clear of the composer
features.description: Open above or below the caret, or clear of your composer with anchorRef. onSubmit gives you the text and the mentions.

states.title: closed
states.description: A plain prompt field with a placeholder. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line.

states.title: open
states.description: A trigger after a space (or at a line’s start, for commands) grows the menu from the caret.

states.title: filtering
states.description: Results narrow and rank as you type, matching text is bold, and the menu’s height animates to fit.

states.title: loading
states.description: An async search shows "Searching" under a sweep of light until results arrive; on later keystrokes the old results stay and a small spinner fades in.

states.title: empty
states.description: "Searching" morphs into "No matches for “xyz”" as its spinner folds away. Escape closes the menu (it sinks away in 160ms) and leaves your text alone.

states.title: chip
states.description: The typed token becomes a tinted chip (or a mono command chip) where it was typed. Backspace removes it whole.
